sentences.zh: 長興四年春正月戊寅朔，帝御明堂殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Changxing, spring, first month, wuyin new moon: the Emperor took the Bright Hall palace to receive court congratulations; guards and retinue were as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin new moon of the first month in spring of Changxing 4 Mingzong received New Year congratulations at the Bright Hall with full ceremonial guard.

sentences.zh: 是日雪盈尺。

translations.literal: That day snow more than a foot.
translations.idiomatic: That day snow piled more than a foot deep.

sentences.zh: 戊子，秦王從榮加守尚書令、兼侍中，依前河南尹，判六軍諸衛事。

translations.literal: On wuzi Prince of Qin Congrong was advanced Acting Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Palace Attendant, as before Mayor of the Eastern Capital Henan, and was empowered over the Six Armies and various guards.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Congrong, Prince of Qin, was made Acting Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Palace Attendant; he remained Mayor of Henan and took charge of the Six Armies and palace guards.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以端明殿學士、尚書兵部侍郎劉煦為中書侍郎、平章事。

translations.literal: On gengyin Palatial Hall academician and Vice Minister of War in the Department of State Affairs Liu Xu was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Counsellor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Liu Xu, academician of the Palatial Hall and Vice Minister of War, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Counsellor.

sentences.zh: 甲午，正衙命使冊故福慶長公主孟氏為晉國雍順長公主，遣太常卿崔居儉赴西川行冊禮。

translations.literal: On jiawu imperial-accoutrements envoys were sent to ennoble the late Lady of Fortune and Celebration long Princess Meng as Long Princess of Jin state Yongshun; Grand Minister of Rites Cui Jujian was dispatched to the Western Circuit to conduct the enfeoffment rite.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu court envoys were commissioned to ennoble the late Princess Meng of Fortune and Celebration as Long Princess Yongshun of Jin; Grand Minister of Rites Cui Jujian was sent to the Western Circuit to perform the investiture.

sentences.zh: 突厥內附。

translations.literal: The Turks submitted internally.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks came in allegiance.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以前河東節度使李從溫為鄆州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengzi former Hedong military commissioner Li Congwen was made Yanzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Li Congwen, former commissioner of Hedong, was made commissioner of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑朔，帝於便殿問範延光內外見管馬數，對曰：「三萬五千匹。

translations.literal: Second month guichou new moon: in the side hall the Emperor asked Fan Yanguang the number of horses under management inside and outside, who replied: "Thirty-five thousand head.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou new moon of the second month the Emperor asked Fan Yanguang in a side hall how many horses the court maintained inside and out; he answered, "Thirty-five thousand."

sentences.zh: 」帝歎曰：「太祖在太願，騎軍不過七千，先皇自始至終馬才及萬。

translations.literal: " The Emperor sighed and said: "When the Founding Emperor was at Taiyuan, cavalry did not exceed seven thousand; the late Emperor from beginning to end horses barely reached ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor sighed and said, "When the Founding Emperor was at Taiyuan his cavalry numbered no more than seven thousand; throughout his reign the late Emperor had barely ten thousand horses."

sentences.zh: 今有鐵馬如是，而不能使九州混一，是吾養士練將之不至也。

translations.literal: Now with iron horses like this, yet unable to make the Nine Provinces unified—this is my failure to nurture officers and train generals.
translations.idiomatic: Now we have armored horses in such numbers, yet we cannot reunite the realm—this shows I have failed to nurture officers and train generals properly."

sentences.zh: 吾老矣，馬將奈何！

translations.literal: I am old; what is to be done with the horses!
translations.idiomatic: I am old—what are we to do with all these horses?"

sentences.zh: 」延光奏曰：「臣每思之，國家養馬太多，試計一騎士之費，可贍步軍五人，三萬五千騎抵十五萬步軍，既無所施，虛耗國力，臣恐日久難繼。

translations.literal: " Yanguang memorialized: "Your servant often reflects on this: the state keeps too many horses. Try calculating one cavalryman's cost—it can support five foot soldiers; thirty-five thousand riders equal one hundred fifty thousand foot, yet there is nowhere to apply them, vainly draining state strength; your servant fears that in time this will be hard to sustain.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguang replied, "I have often thought about this: the state keeps far too many horses. The cost of one cavalryman could support five foot soldiers; thirty-five thousand riders equal a hundred and fifty thousand infantry, yet we have no use for them and are draining the treasury. I fear this cannot be sustained for long."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「誠如卿言，肥騎士而瘠吾民，何益哉！」

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "Truly as you say—fattening cavalry while emaciating our people, what benefit is there!"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "You are right: fattening the cavalry while our people grow lean—what good does that do?"

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note:

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：上問見管馬數，樞密使範延光奏：「天下常支草粟者近五萬匹。

translations.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: The Emperor asked the number of horses under management; Military Affairs Commissioner Fan Yanguang memorialized: "Those regularly drawing fodder and grain empire-wide are nearly fifty thousand head.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Five Dynasties Essentials: When the Emperor asked how many horses were maintained, Fan Yanguang, Military Affairs Commissioner, reported, "Nearly fifty thousand head draw regular fodder and grain stipends empire-wide."

sentences.zh: 見今西北諸道蕃賣馬者往來如市，其郵傳之費、中估之直，日以四十五貫，以臣計之，國力十耗其七，馬無所使，財賦漸消，朝廷甚非所利。

translations.literal: At present in the northwest circuits frontier peoples selling horses come and go like a market; courier costs and middle-estimate prices run forty-five strings a day. By your servant's reckoning, state strength is seven-tenths depleted; horses have no use, revenues gradually vanish—this is very much not to the court's advantage.
translations.idiomatic: Nowadays frontier horse traders in the northwest circuits come and go like a market; courier costs and purchase prices run to forty-five strings a day. By my reckoning the treasury is seven-tenths drained, the horses serve no purpose, and revenues are dwindling—this greatly harms the court."

sentences.zh: 」上善之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 十月，敕沿邊藩鎮，或有蕃部賣馬，可擇其良壯給券，具數以聞。）〉

translations.literal: In the tenth month an edict to frontier military commissions: when frontier peoples sell horses, select the sound and strong, issue certificates, report the numbers in detail.)〉
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month an edict ordered frontier commands that when tribesmen sold horses they should select sound animals, issue certificates, and report the numbers.)〉

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以虔州節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中馬希振為洪州節度使；

translations.literal: On dingsi Qianzhou military commissioner, Acting Grand Preceptor, and concurrent Palace Attendant Ma Xizhen was made Hongzhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Ma Xizhen, commissioner of Qianzhou, Acting Grand Preceptor, and Palace Attendant, was made commissioner of Hongzhou;

sentences.zh: 以鄂州節度使馬希廣為檢校太尉、同平章事，充桂州節度使；

translations.literal: Ezhou military commissioner Ma Xiguang was made Acting Grand Preceptor, Associate Grand Counsellor, and installed as Guizhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xiguang of Ezhou was made Acting Grand Preceptor and Associate Grand Counsellor and installed as commissioner of Guizhou;

sentences.zh: 以盧州節度使兼武安軍副使姚彥章為檢校太尉、同平章事；

translations.literal: Luzhou military commissioner and concurrent Wu'an Army vice commissioner Yao Yanchang was made Acting Grand Preceptor and Associate Grand Counsellor;
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yanchang, commissioner of Luzhou and vice commissioner of the Wu'an Army, was made Acting Grand Preceptor and Associate Grand Counsellor;

sentences.zh: 以靜江節度副使馬希範為鄂州節度使。

translations.literal: Jingjiang military vice commissioner Ma Xifan was made Ezhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xifan, vice commissioner of Jingjiang, was made commissioner of Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 故潞州節度使、檢校太保康君立贈太傅。

translations.literal: The late Luzhou military commissioner, Acting Senior Tutor Kang Junli, was posthumously granted Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Junli, late commissioner of Luzhou and Acting Senior Tutor, was posthumously made Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 己未，宋州節度使安元信加兼侍中。

translations.literal: On jiwei Songzhou military commissioner An Yuanxin was additionally made concurrent Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei An Yuanxin of Songzhou was additionally made Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 濮州進重修河堤圖，沿河地名，曆曆可數。

translations.literal: Puzhou presented a revised map of river dikes; place names along the river could be counted one by one.
translations.idiomatic: Puzhou submitted a revised map of the river dikes, with every place name along the course clearly marked.

sentences.zh: 帝覽之，愀然曰：「吾佐先朝定天下，於此堤塢間小大數百戰。

translations.literal: The Emperor viewed it and, grave-faced, said: "I aided the former court to settle the realm; in these dikes and ramparts large and small, several hundred battles.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor studied it his face fell. He said, "I helped the former court conquer the realm and fought several hundred battles, great and small, along these dikes and embankments."

sentences.zh: 」又指一邱曰：「此吾擐甲台也。

translations.literal: " He also pointed to a mound and said: "This is my platform for donning armor.
translations.idiomatic: He pointed to a mound and said, "That is where I buckled on my armor."

sentences.zh: 時事如昨，奄忽一紀，令人悲歎耳！

translations.literal: Events like yesterday, suddenly a twelve-year cycle—how it makes one grieve and sigh!
translations.idiomatic: It all seems like yesterday, yet twelve years have slipped by in a flash—how it moves one to grief!"

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，以西川節度使孟知祥為劍南東、西兩川節度使，封蜀王。

translations.literal: " On guihai Western Circuit military commissioner Meng Zhixiang was made military commissioner of both Eastern and Western Jiannan circuits and enfeoffed Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Meng Zhixiang of the Western Circuit was made commissioner of both Eastern and Western Jiannan and enfeoffed as Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 三司奏：「當省有諸道鹽鐵轉運使衙職員都押衙、正押衙、同押衙、通引、衙前虞候、子弟，今欲列為三司職名。

translations.literal: The Three Offices memorialized: "This ministry has from the various circuits' salt-and-iron transport commissioners' yamen staff the titles Chief Escort Officer, Principal Escort Officer, Associate Escort Officer, Guide, Yamen Forward Guard, and Retainers; now wishing to list them as Three Offices post titles.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Offices reported, "Our ministry wishes to formalize as Three Offices titles the posts now held by transport commissioners' staff—Chief Escort Officer, Principal Escort Officer, Associate Escort Officer, Guide, Yamen Forward Guard, and Retainers."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以御史中丞崔衍為兵部侍郎，以右諫議大夫龍敏為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On gengwu Censor-in-Chief Cui Yan was made Vice Minister of War; Right Remonstrance Counsellor Long Min was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Cui Yan, Censor-in-Chief, became Vice Minister of War, and Long Min, Right Remonstrance Counsellor, became Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，幸龍門。

translations.literal: Third month jimao: the Emperor visited Longmen.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the third month the Emperor visited Longmen.

sentences.zh: 延州節度使安從進奏，夏州節度使李仁福卒，其子彝超自稱留後。

translations.literal: Yanzhou military commissioner An Congjin memorialized: Xiazhou military commissioner Li Renfu died; his son Yichao styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An Congjin of Yanzhou reported that Li Renfu, commissioner of Xiazhou, had died and that his son Yichao had proclaimed himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲申，鎮州奏，行軍司馬趙瑰、節度判官陸浣、元從押衙高知柔等並棄市，坐受賂枉法殺人也。

translations.literal: On jiashen Zhenzhou memorialized: campaign army marshal Zhao Gui, military commission adjutant Lu Huan, original-follower escort officer Gao Zhirou, and others were all executed in the marketplace, the crime being taking bribes, perverting the law, and killing people.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Zhenzhou reported that campaign marshal Zhao Gui, adjutant Lu Huan, escort officer Gao Zhirou, and others had been executed for taking bribes, perverting justice, and unlawful killing.

sentences.zh: 節度使李從敏罰一季俸。

translations.literal: Military commissioner Li Congmin was fined one season's salary.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Li Congmin was fined one quarter's salary.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以西川節度副使、知武泰軍節度兵馬留後趙季良為檢校太保、黔南節度使；

translations.literal: On yiyou Western Circuit military vice commissioner and acting Wutai Army military commissioner Zhao Jiliang was made Acting Senior Tutor and Qiannan military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Zhao Jiliang, Western Circuit vice commissioner and acting Wutai Army commissioner, was made Acting Senior Tutor and commissioner of Qiannan;

sentences.zh: 以西川諸軍馬步都指揮使、知武信軍節度兵馬留後李仁罕為檢校太傅、遂州節度使；

translations.literal: Western Circuit combined horse-and-foot commander-in-chief and acting Wuxin Army military commissioner Li Renhan was made Acting Grand Tutor and Suizhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Li Renhan, Western Circuit combined forces commander and acting Wuxin Army commissioner, was made Acting Grand Tutor and commissioner of Suizhou;

sentences.zh: 以西川左廂馬步指揮使、知保寧軍節度兵馬留後趙廷隱為檢校太保、閬州節度使；

translations.literal: Western Circuit left wing horse-and-foot commander and acting Baoning Army military commissioner Zhao Tingyin was made Acting Senior Tutor and Langzhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Tingyin, left-wing commander of the Western Circuit and acting Baoning Army commissioner, was made Acting Senior Tutor and commissioner of Langzhou;

sentences.zh: 以西川右廂馬步都指揮使、知寧江軍兵馬留後張知業為檢校司徒、夔州節度使；

translations.literal: Western Circuit right wing horse-and-foot commander-in-chief and acting Ningjiang Army military commissioner Zhang Zhiye was made Acting Minister of Works and Kuizhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhiye, right-wing commander of the Western Circuit and acting Ningjiang Army commissioner, was made Acting Minister of Works and commissioner of Kuizhou;

sentences.zh: 以西川衙內馬步都指揮使、知昭武軍兵馬留後李肇為檢校太保、利州節度使，從孟知祥之請也。

translations.literal: Western Circuit inner-palace horse-and-foot commander-in-chief and acting Zhaowu Army military commissioner Li Zhao was made Acting Senior Tutor and Lizhou military commissioner, following Meng Zhixiang's request.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhao, inner-palace commander of the Western Circuit and acting Zhaowu Army commissioner, was made Acting Senior Tutor and commissioner of Lizhou, at Meng Zhixiang's request.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，賜宰相李愚絹百匹、錢十萬、鋪陳物一十三件。

translations.literal: On bingxu Grand Counsellor Li Yu was granted one hundred bolts of silk, one hundred thousand cash, and thirteen items of furnishings.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Grand Counsellor Li Yu was given a hundred bolts of silk, a hundred thousand cash, and thirteen furnishings.

sentences.zh: 時愚病，帝令近臣翟光鄴宣問，所居寢室，蕭然四壁，病榻弊氈而已。

translations.literal: At the time Yu was ill; the Emperor ordered a close attendant, Zhai Guangye, to convey inquiries. His dwelling chamber was bare on four walls—only a sick couch with worn felt.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yu was then ill; the Emperor sent the attendant Zhai Guangye to inquire after him and found his bedchamber utterly bare, with only a sickbed and a threadbare felt rug.

sentences.zh: 光鄴具言其事，故有是賜。

translations.literal: Guangye reported the matter in full; hence this grant.
translations.idiomatic: Guangye reported this in full, which led to the grant.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以延州節度使安從進為夏州留後，以夏州左都押衙、四州防遏使李彝超為延州留後，仍命邠州節度使藥彥稠、宮苑使安重益帥師援送從進赴鎮。

translations.literal: On wuzi Yanzhou military commissioner An Congjin was made Xiazhou acting commissioner; Xiazhou left chief escort officer and four-prefecture defense commissioner Li Yichao was made Yanzhou acting commissioner; still ordering Binzhou military commissioner Yao Yanchou and Palace Parks Commissioner An Chongyi to lead troops to escort Congjin to his post.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi An Congjin of Yanzhou was made acting commissioner of Xiazhou, and Li Yichao, Xiazhou's left chief escort officer and four-prefecture defense commissioner, was made acting commissioner of Yanzhou; Yao Yanchou of Binzhou and Palace Parks Commissioner An Chongyi were ordered to escort Congjin to his post with troops.

sentences.zh: 以左衛上將軍盧文進為潞州節度使，以右龍武統軍張溫為雲州節度使。

translations.literal: Left Guard senior general Lu Wenjin was made Luzhou military commissioner; Right Martial Dragon supreme general Zhang Wen was made Yunzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Wenjin, senior general of the Left Guard, was made commissioner of Luzhou, and Zhang Wen, supreme general of the Right Martial Dragon Guard, commissioner of Yunzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以鳳翔行軍司馬李彥琮為鹽州防禦使。

translations.literal: On gengyin Fengxiang campaign army marshal Li Yancong was made Yazhou defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Li Yancong, campaign marshal of Fengxiang, was made defense commissioner of Yazhou.

sentences.zh: 時範延光等奏，請因夏州之師製置鹽州，故有是命。

translations.literal: At the time Fan Yanguang and others memorialized requesting that, on the occasion of the Xiazhou expedition, Yazhou be established—hence this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang and others had asked that Yazhou be established in connection with the Xiazhou campaign, which led to this appointment.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以右威衛上將軍安重霸為同州節度使。

translations.literal: On guisi Right Martial Might senior general An Chongba was made Tongzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi An Chongba, senior general of the Right Martial Might Guard, was made commissioner of Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以左龍武統軍符彥超為安州節度使。

translations.literal: On jihai Left Martial Dragon supreme general Fu Yanchao was made Anzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Fu Yanchao, supreme general of the Left Martial Dragon Guard, was made commissioner of Anzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔除放京兆、秦、岐、邠、涇、延、慶、同、華、興元十州長興元年二年係欠夏秋稅物，及營田莊宅務課利，以其曾輦運供軍糧料也。

translations.literal: An edict remitted for Jingzhao, Qin, Qi, Bin, Jing, Yan, Qing, Tong, Hua, and Xingyuan ten prefectures the summer and autumn tax goods owed from Changxing 1 and 2, and farm-estate manor-office levies, because they had once transported and supplied army provisions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict remitted summer and autumn tax arrears from Changxing 1–2 and farm-estate levies for ten prefectures—Jingzhao, Qin, Qi, Bin, Jing, Yan, Qing, Tong, Hua, and Xingyuan—because they had previously transported grain for the army.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，故晉國夫人夏氏追冊皇后，有司上諡曰昭懿，從之。

translations.literal: On jiachen the late Lady of Jin state Xia was posthumously enfeoffed as empress; the responsible offices proposed the posthumous title Zhaoyi; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the late Lady Xia of Jin was posthumously made empress with the temple name Zhaoyi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，李彝超奏：「奉詔除延州留後，已受恩命訖，三軍百姓擁隔，未遂赴任。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month wushen: Li Yichao memorialized: "Having received the edict appointing me Yanzhou acting commissioner, I have already received the gracious commission; yet the three armies and the people block the way, and I have not been able to proceed to my post.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the fourth month Li Yichao reported, "I have received the edict appointing me acting commissioner of Yanzhou and accepted the commission, but the troops and populace are blocking me and I cannot take up the post."

sentences.zh: 」帝遣閣門使蘇繼顏齎詔促彝超赴任。

translations.literal: " The Emperor sent Gate Commissioner Su Jiyan bearing an edict to urge Yichao to proceed to his post.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor sent Gate Commissioner Su Jiyan with an edict urging Yichao to take up his appointment.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以刑部侍郎劉讚為秘書監、秦王傅。

translations.literal: On guichou Vice Minister of Justice Liu Zan was made Director of the Secretariat and Tutor to the Prince of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Liu Zan, Vice Minister of Justice, was made Director of the Secretariat and Tutor to the Prince of Qin.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note:

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：長興四年四月，以秘書監劉讚為秦王傅，前忠武軍節度判官蘇瓚為秦王友，前襄州觀察使魚崇遠為秦王府記室參軍。

translations.literal: (The 《Five Dynasties Essentials》: In the fourth month of Changxing 4, Director of the Secretariat Liu Zan was made Tutor to the Prince of Qin; former Zhongwu Army military commission adjutant Su Zan was made Companion to the Prince of Qin; former Xiangzhou observation commissioner Yu Chongyuan was made Recorder of the Prince of Qin's mansion.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Five Dynasties Essentials: In the fourth month of Changxing 4 Liu Zan, Director of the Secretariat, became Tutor to the Prince of Qin; Su Zan, former adjutant of the Zhongwu Army, became his Companion; and Yu Chongyuan, former observation commissioner of Xiangzhou, became Recorder of the Qin princely establishment.

sentences.zh: 時言事者請為秦王置師傅，上顧問近臣，皆以秦王名勢隆盛，不敢置議，請自選擇，乃降是命。）〉

translations.literal: At the time memorialists asked that tutor and preceptor be installed for the Prince of Qin. The Emperor looked to close attendants; all held that the Prince of Qin's fame and power were too exalted to dare propose, and asked that he choose for himself—then this order was issued.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Memorialists had asked that tutors be appointed for the Prince of Qin. The Emperor consulted his close attendants, who all said the prince's stature was too great for them to propose candidates and asked that he choose himself—hence this order.)〉

sentences.zh: 甲寅，前鄧州節度使梁漢顒以太子少師致仕，太子賓客裴皞以兵部尚書致仕。

translations.literal: On jiayin former Dengzhou military commissioner Liang Hanyong retired as Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent; Heir Apparent Guest Pei Hao retired as Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Liang Hanyong, former commissioner of Dengzhou, retired as Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent, and Pei Hao, Heir Apparent Guest, retired as Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 戊午，追冊昭宗皇后何氏為宣穆皇后，祔饗太廟，百僚進名奉慰，廢朝三日。

translations.literal: On wuwu Empress He, consort of Emperor Zhaozong, was posthumously enfeoffed as Empress Xuanmu, enshrined and offered in the Grand Ancestral Temple; the hundred officials advanced their names in condolence; court was suspended three days.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Empress He of Emperor Zhaozong was posthumously enfeoffed as Empress Xuanmu and given a place in the Grand Ancestral Temple; officials offered condolences and court was suspended for three days.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以左散騎常侍任讚為戶部侍郎，以吏部侍郎藥縱之為曹州刺史。

translations.literal: On jisi Left Regular Attendant Ren Zan was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Vice Minister of Personnel Yao Zongzhi was made Cao prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Ren Zan, Left Regular Attendant, became Vice Minister of Revenue, and Yao Zongzhi, Vice Minister of Personnel, became prefect of Cao.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，延州奏，蕃部劫掠餉運及攻城之具，守蘆關兵士退守金明鎮。

translations.literal: On guiyou Yanzhou memorialized: frontier peoples plundered supply transport and siege equipment; soldiers guarding Luguan Pass withdrew to garrison Jinming town.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Yanzhou reported that frontier tribes had raided supply convoys and siege equipment and that the garrison at Luguan Pass had fallen back to Jinming.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子朔，帝御文明殿受朝。

translations.literal: Fifth month bingzi new moon: the Emperor took the Hall of Civilization to receive court.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi new moon of the fifth month the Emperor held court at the Hall of Civilization.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，皇子鳳翔節度使從珂封潞王。

translations.literal: On wuyin the imperial son, Fengxiang military commissioner Congke, was enfeoffed Prince of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Congke, imperial son and commissioner of Fengxiang, was enfeoffed as Prince of Lu.

sentences.zh: 新授戶部侍郎任讚改刑部侍郎，讚訴以所授官是丁憂闕，故改正。

translations.literal: The newly appointed Vice Minister of Revenue Ren Zan was changed to Vice Minister of Justice; Zan pleaded that the post granted was a vacancy from mourning leave, hence the change.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Zan, newly appointed Vice Minister of Revenue, was reassigned as Vice Minister of Justice after he explained that the Revenue post was a vacancy left by an official in mourning.

sentences.zh: 皇子從益封許王，鄆州節度使李從溫封兗王，河中節度使李從璋封洋王，鎮州節度使李從敏封涇王。

translations.literal: Imperial son Congyi was enfeoffed Prince of Xu; Yanzhou military commissioner Li Congwen Prince of Yan; Hezhong military commissioner Li Congzhang Prince of Yang; Zhenzhou military commissioner Li Congmin Prince of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Congyi was enfeoffed as Prince of Xu; Li Congwen of Yanzhou as Prince of Yan; Li Congzhang of Hezhong as Prince of Yang; and Li Congmin of Zhenzhou as Prince of Jing.

sentences.zh: 甲申，帝避暑於九曲池，既而登樓，風毒暴作，聖體不豫，翌日而愈。

translations.literal: On jiashen the Emperor escaped summer heat at the Nine-Bend Pool; afterward he ascended a tower; wind toxin suddenly struck; the sacred person was unwell; the next day he recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the Emperor took the summer retreat at the Nine-Bend Pool, then climbed a tower; a sudden chill brought on illness, but he recovered the next day.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note:

sentences.zh: （《北夢瑣言》云：上聖體乖和，馮道對寢膳之間，動思調衛，因指御前果實曰：「如食桃不康，翌日見李而思戒可也。

translations.literal: (The 《Northern Dreams Anecdotes》 says: When the Emperor's sacred person was out of harmony, Feng Dao, facing him between sleeping and dining, often thought of regimen. He pointed to fruit before the throne and said: "If eating peaches disagrees with you, the next day seeing plums should make you think to abstain.
translations.idiomatic: (The Northern Dreams Anecdotes records: When the Emperor was unwell Feng Dao, attending him at meals, thought constantly of his regimen. He pointed to fruit on the table and said, "If peaches disagree with you, seeing plums the next day should remind you to be cautious."

sentences.zh: 」初，上因禦李，暴得風虛之疾，馮道不敢斥言，因奏事諷悟上意。）〉

translations.literal: " Earlier the Emperor had eaten plums and suddenly contracted a wind-deficiency illness; Feng Dao dared not speak bluntly and so, while reporting business, admonished by indirection to awaken the Emperor's understanding.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Emperor had eaten plums and been stricken with chills and weakness; Feng Dao dared not speak plainly and used this indirect admonition while reporting on state affairs.)〉

sentences.zh: 丙戌，契丹遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On bingxu the Khitan sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Khitan envoys came to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，安從進奏，大軍已至夏州，攻城，以其不受命也。

translations.literal: On dingyou An Congjin memorialized: the great army had reached Xiazhou and was besieging the city, because it did not accept orders.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou An Congjin reported that the main army had reached Xiazhou and was besieging the city for refusing to submit.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以靈武留後張希崇為本州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengzi Lingwu acting commissioner Zhang Xichong was made military commissioner of that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Zhang Xichong, acting commissioner of Lingwu, was made its full commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，故夏州節度使、朔方郡王李仁福追封虢王。

translations.literal: On xinchou the late Xiazhou military commissioner, Prince of Shuofang commandery Li Renfu, was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Guo.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Li Renfu, late commissioner of Xiazhou and Prince of Shuofang, was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Guo.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以前晉州留後薄文為本州節度使。

translations.literal: On renyin former Jinzhou acting commissioner Bo Wen was made military commissioner of that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Bo Wen, former acting commissioner of Jinzhou, was made its full commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午朔，文武百僚、宰臣馮道等拜章，請於尊號內加「廣運法天」四字，凡拜三章，詔允之。

translations.literal: Sixth month bingwu new moon: civil and military officials of the hundred offices and Grand Counsellor Feng Dao and others submitted memorials requesting that within the honorific title the four characters "Broad Fortune Aligning with Heaven" be added; in all three memorials were submitted; an edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu new moon of the sixth month civil and military officials led by Grand Counsellor Feng Dao thrice petitioned to add "Broad Fortune Aligning with Heaven" to the honorific title, and the Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 詔宮西新園宜名永芳園，其間新殿宜名和慶殿。

translations.literal: An edict: the new garden west of the palace should be named Ever-Fragrant Garden; the new hall within it should be named Harmonious Celebration Hall.
translations.idiomatic: An edict named the new garden west of the palace Ever-Fragrant Garden and its new hall Harmonious Celebration Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，秦王從榮加食邑至萬戶，實封二千戶。

translations.literal: On bingchen Prince of Qin Congrong was advanced in fief households to ten thousand, with actual enfeoffment of two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Congrong, Prince of Qin, received a fief of ten thousand households with two thousand paying enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以右驍衛上將軍李從昶為左龍武統軍，以前邢州節度使高允韜為右龍武統軍，以右驍衛上將軍羅周敬為左羽林統軍，以右監門上將軍婁繼英為金州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingsi Right Martial Valiant senior general Li Congchang was made Left Martial Dragon supreme general; former Xingzhou military commissioner Gao Yuntao Right Martial Dragon supreme general; Right Martial Valiant senior general Luo Zhoujing Left Feathered Forest supreme general; Right Gate Guard senior general Lou Jiying Jin prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Li Congchang of the Right Martial Valiant Guard became supreme general of the Left Martial Dragon Guard; Gao Yuntao, former commissioner of Xingzhou, supreme general of the Right Martial Dragon Guard; Luo Zhoujing of the Right Martial Valiant Guard, supreme general of the Left Feathered Forest Guard; and Lou Jiying of the Right Gate Guard, prefect of Jin.

sentences.zh: 戊午，宋王從厚加食邑至萬戶，實封一千戶。

translations.literal: On wuwu Prince of Song Conghou was advanced in fief households to ten thousand, with actual enfeoffment of one thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Conghou, Prince of Song, received a fief of ten thousand households with one thousand paying enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以前涇州節度使李金全為滄州節度使。

translations.literal: On renxu former Jingzhou military commissioner Li Jinquan was made Cangzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Li Jinquan, former commissioner of Jingzhou, was made commissioner of Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔御史中丞龍敏等詳定《大中統類》。

translations.literal: On guihai an edict ordered Censor-in-Chief Long Min and others to compile in detail the 《Comprehensive Categories of the Dazhong Era》.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai an edict ordered Long Min, Censor-in-Chief, and others to compile the Comprehensive Categories of the Dazhong Era.

sentences.zh: 甲子，第十四女封壽安公主，第十五女封永樂公主。

translations.literal: On jiazi the fourteenth daughter was enfeoffed Princess Shou'an; the fifteenth daughter Princess Yongle.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the fourteenth daughter was made Princess Shou'an and the fifteenth Princess Yongle.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以前利州節度使孫漢韶為洋州節度使。

translations.literal: On wuchen former Lizhou military commissioner Sun Hanshao was made Yangzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Sun Hanshao, former commissioner of Lizhou, was made commissioner of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬申，永寧軍節度使、容州管內觀察使、檢校太尉、兼侍中馬存加食邑實封。

translations.literal: On renshen Yongning Army military commissioner, Rongzhou circuit observation commissioner, Acting Grand Preceptor, and concurrent Palace Attendant Ma Cun was advanced in fief households and actual enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Ma Cun, commissioner of the Yongning Army and Rongzhou, Acting Grand Preceptor and Palace Attendant, received additional fief and enfeoffment income.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，帝復不豫。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the Emperor was again unwell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Emperor fell ill again.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，以著作佐郎尹拙為左拾遺，直史館。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month dingchou: Editorial Assistant Yin Zhuo was made Left Reminder and attached to the Historiography Office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the seventh month Yin Zhuo, Editorial Assistant, was made Left Reminder with concurrent duty in the Historiography Office.

sentences.zh: 國朝舊制，皆以畿赤尉直史館，今用諫官自拙始，從監修李愚奏也。

translations.literal: The dynasty's old rule was that all attached to the Historiography Office were capital-district red-uniform magistrates; now using remonstrance officials began with Zhuo, following supervising compiler Li Yu's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: By old custom only capital-district magistrates served in the Historiography Office; using a remonstrance official began with Zhuo, at supervising compiler Li Yu's request.

sentences.zh: 己卯，東嶽三郎神贈威雄大將軍。

translations.literal: On jimao the Third Son god of the Eastern Peak was granted Mighty and Heroic Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the Third Son of the Eastern Peak was granted the title Mighty and Heroic Grand General.

sentences.zh: 初，帝不豫，前淄州刺史劉遂清薦泰山僧一人，雲善醫，及召見，乃庸僧耳。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Emperor was unwell, former Zizhou prefect Liu Suiqing recommended a Mount Tai monk, saying he was skilled in medicine; when summoned and seen, he was merely a mediocre monk.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor had first fallen ill Liu Suiqing, former prefect of Zi, recommended a Mount Tai monk said to be a fine physician; when summoned the man proved to be a mere charlatan.

sentences.zh: 問方藥，僧曰：「不工醫，嘗於泰山中親睹嶽神，謂僧曰：『吾第三子威靈可愛，而未有爵秩，師為我請之。

translations.literal: Asked about prescriptions, the monk said: "I am not skilled in medicine. Once in Mount Tai I personally saw the Peak god, who told the monk: 'My third son is lovable in majesty yet has no rank or title; Master, request it for me.
translations.idiomatic: Asked for remedies the monk said, "I am no physician. Once on Mount Tai I saw the god of the peak, who told me, 'My third son is full of majesty yet has no rank; please obtain one for him.'"

sentences.zh: 』」宮中神其事，故有是命，識者嫉遂清之妖佞焉。

translations.literal: '" The palace regarded the matter as numinous; hence this appointment. The knowing resented Suiqing's sorcery and flattery.
translations.idiomatic: The palace treated the tale as miraculous and issued the appointment; the knowing blamed Suiqing for superstitious flattery.

sentences.zh: 詔應台官出行，須令人訶引，使軍巡職掌等規避。

translations.literal: An edict: when Censorate officials go out, someone must call and lead the way, causing military patrol officers and the like to yield.
translations.idiomatic: An edict required that Censorate officials on the streets be preceded by a herald so patrol officers would clear the way.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔安從進班師，時王師攻夏州無功故也。

translations.literal: On renwu an edict ordered An Congjin to withdraw the army; at the time the imperial army's attack on Xiazhou had been without success.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu an edict ordered An Congjin to withdraw, as the assault on Xiazhou had failed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以許州節度使孟鵠卒廢朝，贈太傅。

translations.literal: On yiyou Xuzhou military commissioner Meng Hu died; court was suspended; he was granted Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Meng Hu, commissioner of Xuzhou, died; court was suspended and he was posthumously made Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 詔賜在京諸軍將校優給有差。

translations.literal: An edict granted to capital garrison army officers and commanders preferential allowances in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted extra allowances to officers of the capital armies in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 時帝疾未痊，軍士有流言故也。

translations.literal: At the time the Emperor's illness had not healed; there was loose talk among the soldiers—hence this.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was still ill and rumors had spread among the troops.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，兩浙節度使、檢校太傅、守中書令錢元瓘封吳王。

translations.literal: On dinghai Liang-Zhe military commissioner, Acting Grand Tutor, and Acting Secretariat Director Qian Yuanguan was enfeoffed Prince of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Qian Yuanguan of Liang-Zhe, Acting Grand Tutor and Acting Secretariat Director, was enfeoffed as Prince of Wu.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，帝被袞冕，禦明堂殿受冊，徽號曰聖明神武廣運法天文德恭孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Eighth month wushen: the Emperor donned ceremonial robes and cap, took the Bright Hall palace to receive the enfeoffment document; the honorific title was Sagely, Illumined, Divinely Martial, Broad Fortune, Aligning with Heaven, Cultured in Virtue, Reverent and Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the eighth month the Emperor, in full regalia, received his investiture at the Bright Hall as Sagely, Illumined, Divinely Martial, Broad Fortune, Aligning with Heaven, Cultured in Virtue, Reverent and Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，製大赦天下，常赦所不原者咸赦除之。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, he proclaimed a great amnesty for the realm; what ordinary amnesties did not pardon was all pardoned and remitted.
translations.idiomatic: When the ceremony ended he proclaimed a general amnesty, extending even to crimes normally excluded from mercy.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賜侍衛諸軍優給有差。

translations.literal: On jiyou the Palace Guard armies were granted preferential allowances in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the Palace Guard armies received extra allowances in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 時月內再有頒給，自茲府藏無餘積矣。

translations.literal: At the time within the month there were again distributions; from this the treasury had no surplus.
translations.idiomatic: Further distributions within the month left the treasury bare.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以晉州節度使薄文卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On xinhai Jinzhou military commissioner Bo Wen died; court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Bo Wen, commissioner of Jinzhou, died and court was suspended.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以右龍武統軍李從昶為許州節度使。

translations.literal: On dingsi Right Martial Dragon supreme general Li Congchang was made Xuzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Li Congchang, supreme general of the Right Martial Dragon Guard, was made commissioner of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以秘書監高輅卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On wuwu Director of the Secretariat Gao Lue died; court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Gao Lue, Director of the Secretariat, died and court was suspended.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以太子太師致仕符習卒廢朝，贈太師。

translations.literal: On xinyou retired Heir Apparent Grand Tutor Fu Xi died; court was suspended; he was granted Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Fu Xi, retired Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent, died; court was suspended and he was posthumously made Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 辛未，秦王從榮以本官充天下兵馬大元帥，加食邑萬戶，實封三千戶；

translations.literal: On xinwei Prince of Qin Congrong, in his existing office, was installed as Grand Marshal of All Armies and Horses Under Heaven, with fief households advanced by ten thousand and actual enfeoffment of three thousand;
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Congrong, Prince of Qin, was made Grand Marshal of All Armies and Horses Under Heaven while retaining his existing offices, with a fief of ten thousand households and three thousand paying enfeoffment;

sentences.zh: 以右羽林統軍翟璋為晉州節度使；

translations.literal: Right Feathered Forest supreme general Zhai Zhang was made Jinzhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Zhang, supreme general of the Right Feathered Forest Guard, was made commissioner of Jinzhou;

sentences.zh: 以太子賓客馬鎬為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Heir Apparent Guest Ma Hao was made Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Hao, Heir Apparent Guest, was made Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 壬申，幸至德宮。

translations.literal: On renshen the Emperor visited the Palace of Utmost Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the Emperor visited the Palace of Utmost Virtue.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌，以戶部尚書李鈴為兵部尚書，以前戶部尚書韓彥惲為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Ninth month jiaxu: Minister of Revenue Li Ling was made Minister of War; former Minister of Revenue Han Yanhun was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the ninth month Li Ling, Minister of Revenue, became Minister of War, and Han Yanhun, former Minister of Revenue, became Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 丙子，幸至德宮。

translations.literal: On bingzi the Emperor visited the Palace of Utmost Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the Emperor again visited the Palace of Utmost Virtue.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，樞密使範延光、趙延壽並加兼侍中，依前充使。

translations.literal: On wuyin Military Affairs Commissioners Fan Yanguang and Zhao Shou both were additionally made concurrent Palace Attendants, continuing as before in their commissions.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Fan Yanguang and Zhao Shou, Military Affairs Commissioners, were additionally made Palace Attendants while retaining their posts.

sentences.zh: 中書奏：「元帥儀注，諸道節度使以下帶兵權者，階下具軍禮參見；

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: "Grand Marshal protocol: military commissioners of the various circuits and below who hold troop authority, below the steps perform full military rites in audience;
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat reported, "Under Grand Marshal protocol, military commissioners and lower officials with troop authority shall perform full military salute below the steps when attending;"

sentences.zh: 其帶使相者，初見亦展一度公禮。

translations.literal: those bearing commissioner and counsellor titles, on first audience also perform one round of civil rites.
translations.idiomatic: those who also hold commissioner and counsellor titles shall on first audience perform one round of civil salute as well.

sentences.zh: 天下軍務公事，元帥府行帖指揮，其判六軍諸衛事則公牒往來，其官屬軍職，委元帥府奏請。

translations.literal: Empire-wide military affairs and public business: the Grand Marshal's office issues posted orders of command; matters of empowering the Six Armies and various guards use official memoranda back and forth; staff military posts are entrusted to the Grand Marshal's office to memorialize and request.
translations.idiomatic: All military affairs empire-wide shall be directed by posted orders from the Grand Marshal's office; matters concerning the Six Armies and palace guards shall pass by official memorandum; military staff appointments shall be submitted by the Grand Marshal's office.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以兵部侍郎盧詹為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: On guiwei Vice Minister of War Lu Zhan was made Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Lu Zhan, Vice Minister of War, was made Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，宰臣馮道加左僕射，李愚加吏部尚書，劉煦加刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On bingxu Grand Counsellor Feng Dao was advanced Left Vice Director; Li Yu advanced Minister of Personnel; Liu Xu advanced Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Grand Counsellor Feng Dao was made Left Vice Director, Li Yu Minister of Personnel, and Liu Xu Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 戊子，河陽節度使兼侍衛親軍都指揮使康義誠、山南西道節度使檢校太傅張虔釗並加同平章事。

translations.literal: On wuzi Heyang military commissioner and concurrent Palace Guard personal-army commander-in-chief Kang Yicheng, and Shannan West Circuit military commissioner Acting Grand Tutor Zhang Qianzhao, were both advanced Associate Grand Counsellor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Kang Yicheng, commissioner of Heyang and commander of the Palace Guard personal army, and Zhang Qianzhao, commissioner of Shannan West Circuit and Acting Grand Tutor, were both made Associate Grand Counsellors.

sentences.zh: 宣徽南院使、判三司馮贇依前檢校太傅、同中書門下二品，充三司使。

translations.literal: Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat Commissioner and Three Offices supervisor Feng Yun, as before Acting Grand Tutor and Second Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was installed as Three Offices Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yun, Southern Bureau Commissioner and supervisor of the Three Offices, retained Acting Grand Tutor and Second Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery and was installed as Three Offices Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 贇亡父名章，故改平章事為同二品。

translations.literal: Yun's deceased father's name was Zhang; hence Grand Counsellor was changed to Second Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Because Yun's late father was named Zhang, the title Grand Counsellor was changed to Second Rank to avoid the taboo.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，永寧公主石氏進封魏國公主，興平公主趙氏進封齊國公主；

translations.literal: On renxu Princess Yongning Lady Shi was advanced to Princess of Wei state; Princess Xingping Lady Zhao to Princess of Qi state;
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Princess Yongning, née Shi, was advanced to Princess of Wei, and Princess Xingping, née Zhao, to Princess of Qi;

sentences.zh: 皇孫重光、重哲並授銀青光祿大夫、檢校工部尚書，秦王、宋王子也。

translations.literal: Imperial grandsons Chongguang and Chongzhe were both granted Silver-Gleaming Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and Acting Minister of Works—they were sons of the Princes of Qin and Song.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial grandsons Chongguang and Chongzhe were both granted Silver-Gleaming Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and Acting Minister of Works—sons of the Princes of Qin and Song.

sentences.zh: 前洋州節度使梁漢顒以太子少傅致仕。

translations.literal: Former Yangzhou military commissioner Liang Hanyong retired as Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Hanyong, former commissioner of Yangzhou, retired as Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以右龍武統軍高允韜為滑州節度使，以韶州刺史、檢校司空王萬榮為華州節度使。

translations.literal: On dingyou Right Martial Dragon supreme general Gao Yuntao was made Huazhou military commissioner; Shaozhou prefect and Acting Minister of Works Wang Wanrong was made Huazhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Gao Yuntao, supreme general of the Right Martial Dragon Guard, was made commissioner of Huazhou, and Wang Wanrong, prefect of Shaozhou and Acting Minister of Works, commissioner of Hua.

sentences.zh: 萬榮，王妃之父也。

translations.literal: Wanrong was the consort's father.
translations.idiomatic: Wanrong was the father of the imperial consort.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以樞密使趙延壽為汴州節度使，以襄州節度使朱宏昭為檢校太尉、同平章事，充樞密使。

translations.literal: On wuxu Military Affairs Commissioner Zhao Shou was made Bianzhou military commissioner; Xiangzhou military commissioner Zhu Hongzhao was made Acting Grand Preceptor and Associate Grand Counsellor, installed as Military Affairs Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Zhao Shou, Military Affairs Commissioner, was made commissioner of Bianzhou, and Zhu Hongzhao of Xiangzhou Acting Grand Preceptor, Associate Grand Counsellor, and Military Affairs Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時範延光、趙延壽相繼辭退樞密務，及朱宏昭有樞密之命，又麵辭訴，帝叱之曰：「爾輩皆欲離朕左右，怕在眼前，素養爾輩，將何用也！

translations.literal: At the time Fan Yanguang and Zhao Shou successively declined Military Affairs duties; when Zhu Hongzhao received the Military Affairs appointment, he again faced the throne and pleaded; the Emperor rebuked him: "You all wish to leave my side—afraid before my eyes! I have long nurtured you—of what use are you!
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang and Zhao Shou had successively asked to leave the Military Affairs post; when Zhu Hongzhao received the appointment he pleaded again in person. The Emperor rebuked him: "You all want to leave my side—you cannot bear to face me! After all I have done for you, what good are you?"

sentences.zh: 」宏昭退謝，不復敢言。

translations.literal: " Hongzhao withdrew and apologized, no longer daring to speak.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhao withdrew in apology and dared say no more.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎張文寶卒。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Personnel Zhang Wenbao died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wenbao, Vice Minister of Personnel, died.

sentences.zh: 庚子，清海軍節度使錢元璹加檢校太傅、同平章事；

translations.literal: On gengzi Qinghai Army military commissioner Qian Yuanshan was advanced Acting Grand Tutor and Associate Grand Counsellor;
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Qian Yuanshan, commissioner of the Qinghai Army, was made Acting Grand Tutor and Associate Grand Counsellor;

sentences.zh: 中吳、建武等軍節度使錢元尞加檢校太師、兼中書令。

translations.literal: Zhongwu and Jianwu armies military commissioner Qian Yuanliao was advanced Acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Yuanliao, commissioner of the Zhongwu and Jianwu armies, was made Acting Grand Preceptor and Secretariat Director.

sentences.zh: 以前滑州節度使李讚華遙領虔州節度使。

translations.literal: Former Huazhou military commissioner Li Zanhua was made titular Qianzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zanhua, former commissioner of Huazhou, was given titular command of Qianzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔天下兵馬大元帥、秦王從榮班宜在宰臣之上。

translations.literal: On xinchou an edict: the Grand Marshal of All Armies and Horses, Prince of Qin Congrong, his court rank should be above the Grand Counsellors.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou an edict placed Congrong, Grand Marshal and Prince of Qin, in court rank above the Grand Counsellors.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note:

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：秦王從榮加兼中書令，與宰臣分班左右定位，及為天下兵馬元帥。

translations.literal: (The Five Dynasties Essentials: Prince of Qin Congrong was additionally made concurrent Secretariat Director, forming separate rows left and right with Grand Counsellors for positioning, and was made Grand Marshal of All Armies and Horses.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Five Dynasties Essentials: Congrong, Prince of Qin, was additionally made Secretariat Director and took position in a separate row from the Grand Counsellors; he was then made Grand Marshal of All Armies and Horses.

sentences.zh: 敕曰：「秦王位隆將相，望重磐維，委任既崇，等威合異，班位宜在宰臣之上。」）〉

translations.literal: An edict said: "The Prince of Qin's rank towers as general and minister, his prestige weighs as the state's pillar; the commission is already exalted, his dignity should differ—his court rank should be above the Grand Counsellors.")〉
translations.idiomatic: An edict read: "The Prince of Qin stands as general and minister, a pillar of the state; his commission is exalted and his dignity should be distinct—his court rank shall be above the Grand Counsellors.")〉

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以北面行營都指揮使、易州刺史楊檀為振武軍節度使。

translations.literal: On renyin Northern Expedition camp commander-in-chief and Yi prefect Yang Tan was made Zhenwu Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Yang Tan, northern expedition commander and prefect of Yi, was made commissioner of the Zhenwu Army.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，以前同州節度使趙在禮為襄州節度使。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month bingwu: former Tongzhou military commissioner Zhao Zaili was made Xiangzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the tenth month Zhao Zaili, former commissioner of Tongzhou, was made commissioner of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以前滑州節度使張敬詢卒廢朝。

translations.literal: On dingwei former Huazhou military commissioner Zhang Jingxun died; court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Zhang Jingxun, former commissioner of Huazhou, died and court was suspended.

sentences.zh: 以刑部侍郎任讚為兵部侍郎，充元帥府判官。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Justice Ren Zan was made Vice Minister of War and installed as Grand Marshal's office adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Zan, Vice Minister of Justice, was made Vice Minister of War and adjutant of the Grand Marshal's office.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以前鳳翔節度使孫嶽為三司使。

translations.literal: On wuwu former Fengxiang military commissioner Sun Yue was made Three Offices Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Sun Yue, former commissioner of Fengxiang, was made Three Offices Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以樞密使範延光為鎮州節度使，以三司使馮贇為樞密使。

translations.literal: On gengshen Military Affairs Commissioner Fan Yanguang was made Zhenzhou military commissioner; Three Offices Commissioner Feng Yun was made Military Affairs Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Fan Yanguang, Military Affairs Commissioner, was made commissioner of Zhenzhou, and Feng Yun, Three Offices Commissioner, Military Affairs Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以前潞州節度使李承約為左龍武統軍；

translations.literal: On xinyou former Luzhou military commissioner Li Chengyue was made Left Martial Dragon supreme general;
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Li Chengyue, former commissioner of Luzhou, was made supreme general of the Left Martial Dragon Guard;

sentences.zh: 以前威寨軍節度使王景戡為右龍武統軍；

translations.literal: former Weizhai Army military commissioner Wang Jingzhan Right Martial Dragon supreme general;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jingzhan, former commissioner of the Weizhai Army, supreme general of the Right Martial Dragon Guard;

sentences.zh: 以左驍衛上將軍安崇阮為左神武統軍；

translations.literal: Left Martial Valiant senior general An Chongruan Left Divine Martial supreme general;
translations.idiomatic: An Chongruan, senior general of the Left Martial Valiant Guard, supreme general of the Left Divine Martial Guard;

sentences.zh: 以右監門上將軍高允貞為右神武統軍。

translations.literal: Right Gate Guard senior general Gao Yunzhen Right Divine Martial supreme general.
translations.idiomatic: and Gao Yunzhen, senior general of the Right Gate Guard, supreme general of the Right Divine Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以權知夏州事、檢校司空李彝超為夏州節度使、檢校司徒。

translations.literal: On renxu acting Xiazhou affairs commissioner and Acting Minister of Works Li Yichao was made Xiazhou military commissioner and Acting Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Li Yichao, acting commissioner of Xiazhou and Acting Minister of Works, was made full commissioner of Xiazhou and Acting Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔在朝文武臣僚並與加恩，以受冊尊號也。

translations.literal: On bingyin an edict: civil and military officials at court were all granted favor, because of receiving the enfeoffment honorific.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin an edict granted favors to all civil and military officials at court in celebration of the investiture.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以前安州節度使楊漢章為兗州節度使，以前雲州節度使張敬達為徐州節度使。

translations.literal: On wuchen former Anzhou military commissioner Yang Hanzhang was made Yanzhou military commissioner; former Yunzhou military commissioner Zhang Jingda Xuzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Yang Hanzhang, former commissioner of Anzhou, was made commissioner of Yan, and Zhang Jingda, former commissioner of Yunzhou, commissioner of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以前兗州節度使張延朗為秦州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengwu former Yanzhou military commissioner Zhang Yanlang was made Qinzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Zhang Yanlang, former commissioner of Yanzhou, was made commissioner of Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬申，秦州節度使劉仲殷移鎮宋州。

translations.literal: On renshen Qinzhou military commissioner Liu Zhongyin transferred to garrison Songzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Liu Zhongyin, commissioner of Qinzhou, was transferred to Songzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，以前滄州節度使盧質為右僕射。

translations.literal: Eleventh month bingzi: former Cangzhou military commissioner Lu Zhi was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the eleventh month Lu Zhi, former commissioner of Cangzhou, was made Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，改慎州懷化軍為昭化軍，升洮州為保順軍。

translations.literal: On gengchen Shen prefecture's Huaihua Army was changed to Zhaohua Army; Taozhou was elevated to Baoshun Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the Huaihua Army at Shenzhou was renamed Zhaohua Army and Taozhou was elevated to Baoshun Army.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以保大軍節度使、檢校太尉鮑君福為保順軍節度、洮鄯等州觀察等使；

translations.literal: On xinsi Baoda Army military commissioner and Acting Grand Preceptor Bao Junfu was made Baoshun Army military commissioner and Taozhou-Shanzhou and other prefectures observation commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Bao Junfu, commissioner of the Baoda Army and Acting Grand Preceptor, was made commissioner of Baoshun Army and observation commissioner of Taozhou, Shanzhou, and adjacent prefectures;

sentences.zh: 以彰義軍節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事杜建徽為昭化軍節度、慎瑞司等州觀察使。

translations.literal: Zhangyi Army military commissioner, Acting Grand Preceptor, and Associate Grand Counsellor Du Jianhui was made Zhaohua Army military commissioner and Shen-Rui-Si and other prefectures observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: and Du Jianhui, commissioner of the Zhangyi Army, Acting Grand Preceptor and Associate Grand Counsellor, commissioner of Zhaohua Army and observation commissioner of Shen, Rui, Si, and adjacent prefectures.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以前汴州節度使李從嚴為鄆州節度使，以鄆州節度使李從溫為定州節度使。

translations.literal: On yiyou former Bianzhou military commissioner Li Congyan was made Yanzhou military commissioner; Yanzhou military commissioner Li Congwen was made Dingzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Li Congyan, former commissioner of Bianzhou, was made commissioner of Yanzhou, and Li Congwen of Yanzhou commissioner of Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，新授右僕射盧質奏：「臣忝除官，合赴省上事，若準舊例，左右僕射上事儀注所費極多，欲從權務簡，隻取尚書丞、郎上事例，止集南省屬僚及兩省官送上，亦不敢輒援往例，有費官用，自量力排比；

translations.literal: On bingxu the newly appointed Right Vice Director Lu Zhi memorialized: "Your servant is shamed to receive appointment and should go to the ministry to assume office. If following the old precedent, the protocol for Left and Right Vice Directors assuming office costs extremely much. Wishing to exercise discretion and keep it simple, take only the precedent of Vice Directors and bureau directors assuming office—only gather southern ministry subordinates and officials of both secretariats to escort—also not daring rashly to invoke past precedent and waste official funds; will arrange by my own means;
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Lu Zhi, newly appointed Right Vice Director, memorialized: "Having received this appointment I should report to the ministry. The traditional ceremony for a Vice Director costs a great deal. I wish to simplify matters and follow only the precedent for vice directors and bureau chiefs—gathering only southern ministry staff and officials of both secretariats—and not invoke the full old ceremony or waste public funds; I will arrange what I can afford;"

sentences.zh: 兼不敢自臣隳廢前規，他時任行舊制。

translations.literal: also not daring on my own to destroy former regulations; another time the old system may be followed.
translations.idiomatic: nor do I mean to abolish the old regulations permanently—others may follow the full ceremony in future."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 戊子，帝不豫。

translations.literal: On wuzi the Emperor was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the Emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大漸，自廣壽殿移居雍和殿。

translations.literal: On jichou he was critically ill and moved from the Hall of Broad Longevity to the Hall of Harmonious Peace.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou his condition grew critical and he was moved from the Hall of Broad Longevity to the Hall of Harmonious Peace.

sentences.zh: 是夜四鼓後，帝自禦榻蹶然而興，顧謂知漏宮女曰：「今夜漏幾何？

translations.literal: That night after the fourth watch, the Emperor suddenly rose from the imperial couch and, turning, asked the palace woman who kept the clepsydra: "Tonight how many watches of the clepsydra?
translations.idiomatic: That night after the fourth watch the Emperor suddenly sat up on his couch and asked the clepsydra attendant, "What watch is it?"

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「四更。

translations.literal: " She replied: "Fourth watch.
translations.idiomatic: She answered, "The fourth watch."

sentences.zh: 」因奏曰：「官家省事否？

translations.literal: " She then reported: "Does the August One feel relieved?
translations.idiomatic: She then asked, "Does Your Majesty feel any better?"

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「省。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "Relieved.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "A little."

sentences.zh: 」因唾出肉片如肺者數片，便溺升餘。

translations.literal: " He then spat out several pieces of flesh like lungs and voided more than a sheng of urine.
translations.idiomatic: He then spat out several lung-like pieces of flesh and passed more than a sheng of urine.

sentences.zh: 六宮皆至，慶躍而奏曰：「官家今日實還魂也。

translations.literal: The Six Palaces all arrived and, leaping for joy, reported: "The August One today has truly returned to life.
translations.idiomatic: The palace women all came and cried with joy, "Your Majesty has truly come back to life today!"

sentences.zh: 」已進食一器，侍醫進湯膳。

translations.literal: " Food of one vessel was already presented; attending physicians presented broth and meals.
translations.idiomatic: A bowl of food was brought and the physicians served broth.

sentences.zh: 至曙，帝小康。

translations.literal: By dawn the Emperor was slightly recovered.
translations.idiomatic: By dawn he had improved somewhat.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，天下大元帥、守尚書令、兼侍中、秦王從榮領兵陣於天津橋，內出禁軍拒之。

translations.literal: On renchen Grand Marshal of All Armies Under Heaven, Acting Director of the Department of State Affairs, and concurrent Palace Attendant Prince of Qin Congrong led troops and formed battle lines at the Tianjin Bridge; from within the palace the forbidden army went out to resist him.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Congrong, Grand Marshal, Acting Director of the Department of State Affairs, Palace Attendant, and Prince of Qin, drew up his troops at the Tianjin Bridge; the palace guard marched out to oppose him.

sentences.zh: 從榮敗奔河南府，遇害。

translations.literal: Congrong was defeated, fled to the Henan prefectural seat, and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Congrong was defeated, fled to the Henan prefectural seat, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 帝聞之，悲駭，幾落禦榻，氣絕而蘇者再，由是不豫有加。

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard it he was grieved and shocked, nearly falling from the imperial couch; breath stopped and he revived twice—hence his illness grew worse.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor heard the news he was stricken with grief and nearly fell from his couch; twice he lost consciousness and revived, and his illness grew worse.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，馮道率百僚見帝於雍和殿，帝雨泣哽噎，曰：「吾家事若此，慚見卿等！

translations.literal: On guisi Feng Dao led the hundred officials to see the Emperor at the Hall of Harmonious Peace; the Emperor wept in rain and choked, saying: "My family affairs are like this—I am ashamed to face you!
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Feng Dao led the officials to the Hall of Harmonious Peace. The Emperor wept and said through his tears, "My family has come to this—I am ashamed to face you!"

sentences.zh: 」百僚皆泣下沾襟。

translations.literal: " The hundred officials all wept until their lapels were soaked.
translations.idiomatic: All the officials wept until their robes were wet.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賜宰臣、樞密使禦衣玉帶，康義誠已下錦帛鞍馬有差。

translations.literal: On jiawu Grand Counsellors and Military Affairs Commissioners were granted imperial robes and jade belts; from Kang Yicheng downward, brocade, silk, saddles, and horses in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the Grand Counsellors and Military Affairs Commissioners received imperial robes and jade belts; from Kang Yicheng downward, brocade, saddles, and horses in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 遣宣徽使孟漢瓊召宋王於鄴都。

translations.literal: Palace Secretariat Commissioner Meng Hanqiong was dispatched to summon the Prince of Song from Yedu.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Secretariat Commissioner Meng Hanqiong was sent to summon the Prince of Song from Yedu.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以三司使孫嶽為亂兵所害廢朝。

translations.literal: On yiwei Three Offices Commissioner Sun Yue was killed by mutinous troops; court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Sun Yue, Three Offices Commissioner, was killed by mutinous troops and court was suspended.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，敕秦王府官屬，除諮議參軍高輦已處斬外，元帥府判官、兵部侍郎任讚配武州，秘書監兼秦王傅劉讚配嵐州，河南少尹劉陟配均州，並為長流百姓，縱逢恩赦，不在放還。

translations.literal: On dingyou an edict on Qin princely establishment staff: except Advisory Assistant Gao Nian, already executed, Grand Marshal's office adjutant and Vice Minister of War Ren Zan was banished to Wuzhou; Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Tutor to the Prince of Qin Liu Zan to Lanzhou; Henan Vice Mayor Liu Sheng to Junzhou—all as long-exile commoners; even if encountering amnesty, not among those released and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou an edict punished the staff of the Qin princely establishment: Advisory Assistant Gao Nian had already been executed; Grand Marshal's adjutant Ren Zan, Vice Minister of War, was exiled to Wuzhou; Liu Zan, Director of the Secretariat and Tutor to the Prince of Qin, to Lanzhou; and Liu Sheng, Henan Vice Mayor, to Junzhou—all as permanent exiles never to be recalled even by amnesty.

sentences.zh: 河南少尹李蕘配石州，河南府判官司徒詡配寧州，秦王友蘇瓚配萊州，記室參軍魚崇遠配慶州，河南府推官王說配隨州，並為長流百姓。

translations.literal: Henan Vice Mayor Li Rao to Shizhou; Henan prefectural judge Situ Xu to Ningzhou; Companion to the Prince of Qin Su Zan to Laizhou; Recorder Yu Chongyuan to Qingzhou; Henan prefectural investigating officer Wang Yue to Suizhou—all as long-exile commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Li Rao, Henan Vice Mayor, was exiled to Shizhou; Situ Xu, Henan prefectural judge, to Ningzhou; Su Zan, Companion to the Prince of Qin, to Laizhou; Yu Chongyuan, Recorder, to Qingzhou; and Wang Yue, Henan investigating officer, to Suizhou—all as permanent exiles.

sentences.zh: 河南府推官尹諲，六軍巡官董裔、張九思，河南府巡官張沆、李潮、江文蔚並勒歸田里。

translations.literal: Henan prefectural investigating officer Yin Shen; Six Armies patrol officers Dong Yi and Zhang Jiusi; Henan prefectural patrol officers Zhang Hong, Li Chao, and Jiang Wenwei were all ordered to return to their home districts.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Shen, Henan investigating officer; Dong Yi and Zhang Jiusi, Six Armies patrol officers; and Zhang Hong, Li Chao, and Jiang Wenwei, Henan patrol officers, were all ordered home.

sentences.zh: 應長流人並除名。

translations.literal: All who were long-exiled were also struck from the registers.
translations.idiomatic: All permanent exiles were also struck from the registers.

sentences.zh: 六軍判官、殿中監王居敏責授復州司馬，六軍推官郭晙責授坊州司戶，並員外置，所在馳驛發遣。

translations.literal: Six Armies adjutant and Palace Reception Supervisor Wang Jumin was demoted and appointed Fuzhou vice prefect; Six Armies investigating officer Guo Jun demoted and appointed Fangzhou registrar—both supernumerary appointments; wherever they were, dispatch by urgent relay.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jumin, Six Armies adjutant and Palace Reception Supervisor, was demoted to vice prefect of Fuzhou; Guo Jun, Six Armies investigating officer, to registrar of Fangzhou—both supernumerary posts—and they were sent off by urgent relay.

sentences.zh: 時宰相、樞密使共議任讚等已下罪，馮道等曰：「任讚前在班行，比與從榮無舊，除官未及月餘，便逢此禍。

translations.literal: At the time Grand Counsellors and Military Affairs Commissioners jointly discussed the crimes of Ren Zan and those below. Feng Dao and others said: "Ren Zan was formerly in the court ranks and had no old tie with Congrong; appointed less than a month when he met this disaster.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Counsellors and Military Affairs Commissioners then debated the guilt of Ren Zan and the others. Feng Dao said, "Ren Zan had long served at court and had no prior tie to Congrong; he had held office less than a month when this calamity struck him.

sentences.zh: 王居敏、司徒詡疾病請假，將近半年，近日之事，計不同謀。

translations.literal: Wang Jumin and Situ Xu were on sick leave for illness, nearly half a year; recent affairs—presumably they did not conspire together.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jumin and Situ Xu had been on sick leave for nearly half a year; they can hardly have plotted in recent events.

sentences.zh: 從榮所款昵者高輦、劉陟、王說三人，昨從榮稱兵指闕之際，沿路隻與劉陟、高輦並轡耳語，至天津橋南，指日影謂諸判官曰：『明日如今，已誅王居敏矣。

translations.literal: Those Congrong was intimate with were Gao Nian, Liu Sheng, and Wang Yue—the three. Yesterday when Congrong raised troops and pointed at the palace, along the road he only rode bridle to bridle whispering with Liu Sheng and Gao Nian; reaching south of the Tianjin Bridge he pointed at the sun's shadow and told the various adjutants: 'Tomorrow at this time, Wang Jumin will already be executed.
translations.idiomatic: Congrong's intimates were Gao Nian, Liu Sheng, and Wang Yue. When he marched on the palace he rode whispering only with Liu Sheng and Gao Nian; south of the Tianjin Bridge he pointed at the sun and told his adjutants, 'By this hour tomorrow Wang Jumin will be dead.'

sentences.zh: 』則知其冗泛之徒，不可一例從坐。

translations.literal: '" Then one knows the redundant and miscellaneous sort cannot be punished by the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: This shows that the rest were mere hangers-on and should not all be punished alike.

sentences.zh: 」朱宏昭意欲盡誅任讚已下，馮贇力爭之乃已。

translations.literal: " Zhu Hongzhao wished to execute Ren Zan and those below to the last man; Feng Yun argued forcefully and only then did it stop.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hongzhao had wanted to execute Ren Zan and all the rest; only Feng Yun's forceful protest stopped him.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，帝崩於大內之雍和殿，壽六十七。

translations.literal: On wuxu the Emperor died in the inner palace's Hall of Harmonious Peace, age sixty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the Emperor died in the Hall of Harmonious Peace within the inner palace, aged sixty-seven.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯朔，遷梓宮於二儀殿，宋王從厚自鄴都至。

translations.literal: Twelfth month guimao new moon: the coffin was moved to the Hall of the Two Principles; Prince of Song Conghou arrived from Yedu.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao new moon of the twelfth month the coffin was moved to the Hall of the Two Principles and Conghou, Prince of Song, arrived from Yedu.

sentences.zh: 是日發哀，百僚縞素於位，中書侍郎、平章事劉煦宣遺製，宋王從厚於柩前即皇帝位，服紀以日易月，一如舊制雲。

translations.literal: That day mourning was proclaimed; the hundred officials in white hemp at their posts; Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Counsellor Liu Xu proclaimed the testamentary edict; Prince of Song Conghou at the bier assumed the imperial throne; mourning regulations counting days as months, all as the old system.
translations.idiomatic: That day mourning was proclaimed; officials stood in white; Liu Xu, Vice Director and Grand Counsellor, read the testamentary edict; and Conghou took the throne before the bier, observing mourning by counting days as months according to custom.

sentences.zh: 明年四月，太常卿盧文紀上諡議曰聖智仁德欽孝皇帝，廟號明宗，宰臣馮道議請改「聖智仁德」四字，為聖德和武欽孝皇帝。

translations.literal: The next year, fourth month, Grand Minister of Rites Lu Wenji submitted the posthumous-title proposal as Sagely, Wise, Benevolent, Cultured, Reverent and Filial Emperor; temple name Mingzong. Grand Counsellor Feng Dao proposed changing the four characters "Sagely, Wise, Benevolent, Cultured" to Sagely, Cultured, Harmonious, Martial, Reverent and Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the following year Lu Wenji, Grand Minister of Rites, proposed the posthumous title Sagely, Wise, Benevolent, Cultured, Reverent and Filial Emperor and the temple name Mingzong; Feng Dao proposed changing the middle four characters to Sagely, Cultured, Harmonious, Martial, Reverent and Filial.

sentences.zh: 宰臣劉煦撰諡冊文，宰臣李愚撰哀冊文，是月二十七日葬於徽陵。

translations.literal: Grand Counsellor Liu Xu composed the posthumous-title document; Grand Counsellor Li Yu composed the lamentation document; on the twenty-seventh of that month burial was at Huiling.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xu composed the posthumous-title text and Li Yu the lamentation text; on the twenty-seventh of that month Mingzong was buried at Huiling.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note:

sentences.zh: （《五代史補》：明宗之在位也，一日幸倉場觀納，時主者以車駕親臨，懼得罪，其較量甚輕。

translations.literal: (Supplement to the History of the Five Dynasties: While Mingzong was on the throne, one day he visited the granary depot to observe intake. At the time the person in charge, because the imperial carriage came in person, feared punishment and measured very lightly.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Supplement to the History of the Five Dynasties: Once during Mingzong's reign he visited a granary to observe the intake. The steward, fearing punishment because the Emperor came in person, measured the grain very lightly.

sentences.zh: 明宗因謂之曰：「且朕自省事以來，倉場給散，動經一二十年未畢，今輕量如此，其後銷折將何以償之？

translations.literal: Mingzong therefore said to him: "Moreover, since I began economizing, granary distribution often takes one or two decades to finish. Now measuring so lightly—afterward when losses are written off, how will you repay them?
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong said to him, "Since I began to economize, granary distributions often take ten or twenty years to complete. If you measure so lightly now, how will you make good the losses when they are written off?"

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「竭盡家產，不足則繼之以身命。

translations.literal: " He replied: "Exhaust family property; if insufficient, follow with body and life.
translations.idiomatic: He answered, "I would exhaust my family's property, and if that were not enough, my own life."

sentences.zh: 」明宗愴然曰：「隻聞百姓養一家，未聞一家養百姓。

translations.literal: " Mingzong, mournful, said: "I have only heard of the hundred surnames nourishing one family—I have not heard of one family nourishing the hundred surnames.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong said sadly, "I have only ever heard of the people supporting one family—not of one family supporting the people."

sentences.zh: 今後每石加二斗耗，以備鼠雀侵蠹，謂之鼠雀耗。

translations.literal: From now on for each shi add two dou allowance, to guard against rats, sparrows, infestation, and worms—called the rat-and-sparrow allowance.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth two dou per shi were added as allowance against rats, sparrows, and spoilage—the "rat-and-sparrow allowance."

sentences.zh: 」倉糧加耗，自此始也。

translations.literal: " The granary grain surcharge began from this.
translations.idiomatic: Thus began the practice of adding surcharges to granary grain.)〉

sentences.zh: 《五代史闕文》：明宗出自邊地，老於戰陳，即位之歲，年已六旬，純厚仁慈，本乎天性。

translations.literal: Lost Texts of the History of the Five Dynasties: Mingzong came from the frontier, old in battle formations; in the year he took the throne he was already in his sixties—pure, thick, benevolent, and kind by inborn nature.
translations.idiomatic: Lost Texts of the History of the Five Dynasties: Mingzong came from the frontier and was a veteran of the battlefield; when he took the throne he was already in his sixties, and his pure, benevolent nature was inborn.

sentences.zh: 每夕宮中焚香仰天禱祝云「某蕃人也，遇世亂為眾推戴，事不獲已，願上天早生聖人，與百姓為主。

translations.literal: Each evening in the palace he burned incense and prayed heavenward, saying: "I am a frontier man; encountering worldly chaos I was pushed forward by the multitude—the affair was not of my choosing. May Heaven soon produce a sage to be lord for the hundred surnames.
translations.idiomatic: Each evening in the palace he burned incense and prayed to Heaven: "I am a man of the frontier; in troubled times the multitude thrust me forward though I had no wish for it. May Heaven soon send a sage to rule the people."

sentences.zh: 」故天成、長興間，比歲豐登，中原無事，言於五代，粗為小康。）〉

translations.literal: " Therefore between Tiancheng and Changxing, year after year harvests were abundant, the central plain was without incident—speaking among the Five Dynasties, it was roughly a modest peace.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Hence between Tiancheng and Changxing harvests were good year after year and the central plain was at peace—a modest prosperity rare among the Five Dynasties.)〉

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：明宗戰伐之勳，雖高佐命，潛躍之事，本不經心。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: Mingzong's merit in battle and campaigning, though lofty in aiding the mandate, the matter of hidden ascent he never had in mind.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer writes: Though Mingzong's military achievements in founding the dynasty were great, he never set his heart on seizing the throne.

sentences.zh: 會王室之多艱，屬神器之自至，諒由天讚，匪出人謀。

translations.literal: It happened that the royal house met many hardships; the regalia of rule came to him of itself—surely through Heaven's aid, not from human design.
translations.idiomatic: When the royal house fell into hardship the regalia came to him unbidden—surely by Heaven's favor, not by human scheming.

sentences.zh: 及應運以君臨，能力行於王化，政皆中道，時亦小康，近代已來，亦可宗也。

translations.literal: When he answered the age to rule as sovereign, he was able to practice kingly transformation; government was all the middle way, the time also a modest peace—since recent times, he may also be taken as a model.
translations.idiomatic: Once he ruled in accord with the times he was able to carry out humane governance; his policies were moderate and the age knew a modest peace—among rulers of recent times he may be honored as an example.

sentences.zh: 倘使重誨得房、杜之術，從榮有啟、誦之賢，則宗祧未至於危亡，載祀或期於綿遠矣。

translations.literal: If only Chonghui had obtained the arts of Fang and Du, Congrong the worthies of Qi and Song—then the ancestral temple would not have reached danger and ruin, the years of sacrifice might have been expected to extend far.
translations.idiomatic: Had Chonghui possessed the counsel of Fang Xuanling and Du Ruhui, and Congrong the virtue of Qi and Song—then the dynasty might not have fallen into peril and its line might have endured.

sentences.zh: 惜乎！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 君親可輔，臣子非才，遽泯烝嘗，良可深歎矣！

translations.literal: The ruler and father could be aided, but ministers and sons lacked talent; suddenly the ancestral sacrifices were extinguished—truly worthy of deep sighing!
translations.idiomatic: The ruler could have been well served, but his ministers and sons lacked the talent; the ancestral rites were cut short all too soon—how deeply to be lamented!
